verses.ar: لِدَاوُدَ. مَزْمُورٌ رَحْمَةً وَحُكْمًا أُغَنِّي. لَكَ يَارَبُّ أُرَنِّمُ.
verses.kjv: A Psalm of David. I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.
verses.web: A Psalm by David. I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, Yahweh, I will sing praises.

verses.ar: أَتَعَقَّلُ فِي طَرِيقٍ كَامِلٍ. مَتَى تَأْتِي إِلَيَّ؟ أَسْلُكُ فِي كَمَالِ قَلْبِي فِي وَسَطِ بَيْتِي.
verses.kjv: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
verses.web: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.

verses.ar: لَا أَضَعُ قُدَّامَ عَيْنَيَّ أَمْرًا رَدِيئًا. عَمَلَ ٱلزَّيَغَانِ أَبْغَضْتُ. لَا يَلْصَقُ بِي.
verses.kjv: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; [it] shall not cleave to me.
verses.web: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.

verses.ar: قَلْبٌ مُعْوَجٌّ يَبْعُدُ عَنِّي. ٱلشِّرِّيرُ لَا أَعْرِفُهُ.
verses.kjv: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked [person].
verses.web: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِي يَغْتَابُ صَاحِبَهُ سِرًّا هَذَا أَقْطَعُهُ. مُسْتَكْبِرُ ٱلْعَيْنِ وَمُنْتَفِخُ ٱلْقَلْبِ لَا أَحْتَمِلُهُ.
verses.kjv: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.
verses.web: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.

verses.ar: عَيْنَايَ عَلَى أُمَنَاءِ ٱلْأَرْضِ لِكَيْ أُجْلِسَهُمْ مَعِي. ٱلسَّالِكُ طَرِيقًا كَامِلًا هُوَ يَخْدِمُنِي.
verses.kjv: Mine eyes [shall be] upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.
verses.web: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.

verses.ar: لَا يَسْكُنُ وَسَطَ بَيْتِي عَامِلُ غِشٍّ. ٱلْمُتَكَلِّمُ بِٱلْكَذِبِ لَا يَثْبُتُ أَمَامَ عَيْنَيَّ.
verses.kjv: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.
verses.web: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.

verses.ar: بَاكِرًا أُبِيدُ جَمِيعَ أَشْرَارِ ٱلْأَرْضِ، لِأَقْطَعَ مِنْ مَدِينَةِ ٱلرَّبِّ كُلَّ فَاعِلِي ٱلْإِثْمِ.
verses.kjv: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.
verses.web: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from Yahweh’s city.
